title: Long term names wrap in the vendor dropdown and card
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have the shop's own term A with a 31-character name, held by vendor A.
  • Then make sure term A is deactivated.
  • Have the shop's own active term B, also with a 31-character name.
custom_steps:
1. Open vendor A's vendor page.
  2. Open Edit Vendor.
  3. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card shows the whole of "term A (Inactive)", wrapping if needed.

Step 2:

  • The selected value shows the whole name and "(Inactive)".

Step 3:

  • Term B and "term A (Inactive)" show in full.
  • Long names wrap, nothing is cut off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R6: “Term names are never cut off in the vendor Credit Terms dropdown or on the vendor card, including with "(Inactive)"; long names wrap.”
